The main difference with my last submission is that I noticed the playground's treatment of {history.attempts} is different from the repo's pipeline (_format_history in pipeline/proxy.py) which clips each attempt to ~600 chars, so I removed my use of {history.attempts} and rendered my own summary from the judge responses. 
This one solves all the problems on the playground locally and I checked the hairiest ones in the playground too and everything I checked got solved.
